verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing showing that GlitchTip issues report affected-user or affected-session counts. The only impact-related mention is alerting 'based on the frequency of errors', which is the raw event count the story wants to move away from. The vague 'Deeper reporting' blog headline does not establish blast-radius metrics.

support.subject: As an SRE, every issue quantifies real impact — how many users and sessions are affected — so I prioritize by blast radius, not raw event counts
